identity_blinding: A/B identities were not requested or resolved. No mapping, named runs, skill packages, freeze files, or repository launch documents were read.
scoring: Four common dimensions, each 0/1/2; total maximum 8 per artifact. Case-check statuses are separate and are not added to that total.

inspection.read: All three anonymous task files; finished editorial files, SVGs, launch-card notes, demo packet text and HTML; supplied primary inputs needed to assess claims.
inspection.visual: Both 1200x630 launch-card PNGs and both 600x315 previews; supplied-reference renders; both 891x1260 demo poster previews.
independent_read_only_checks: Editorial word counts within 500-800 (approximately 702 for A and 685 for B using a word-token counter).
Both card SVGs parse; exact 1200/630 dimensions and viewBox; all five required visible strings; icon shape attributes/fills equal the supplied icon; no image/script/foreignObject/href assets.
PNG IHDR dimensions match the requested full and half sizes; previews were visually opened.
Markdown file links resolve; B demo HTML local links and anchors resolve, with no duplicate IDs, scripts, or src loads.
A demo poster/icon files match supplied bytes; B HTML contains the exact supplied poster/icon text.
Narration spoken whitespace counts: A 161 words, B 205 words, matching their estimates.
not_performed: No output helper scripts or supplied repository code were executed.
No browser, network, new dependencies, model exercise, timed narration, audience testing, print proof, or cross-editor rendering.
No independent execution-trace audit of each producer's historical claims; supported structural checks were repeated directly.

case_checks.evidence: Finished account is in range, with an honest release formulation and a discriminating future observation; no unsupported discovery found.

case_checks.check: Finished readable account and source trail, without fictional discoveries

concrete_differences: A explicitly considers whether the creative direction is merely packaging and whether the evidence is generally inflated; the available artifacts and disclosed caveats weaken those rivals. B reaches the same central conclusion with less explicit rival analysis.
B adds the supported historical Calendar failure/retest; A uses a more concrete Gmail-first narrative. Both explain the crucial scope distinction correctly.
pairs.preference_reason: A narrowly better meets the frozen rival-explanation check. This is an editorial and investigative difference, not evidence that its anonymous procedure is more effective.
possible_unblinding_clues: No explicit trial-arm identity in the deliverables. Different citation and source-trail styles could suggest process, but were not used to infer labels.

concrete_differences: B gathers the artifact, source limits, narration and complete first task in one offline HTML entrypoint; A distributes the same review functions across Markdown and asset files.

B supplies a new three-study invitation exercise with all reference inputs in the prompt. A supplies a square companion task based on the included poster. Both are usable and honestly distinguish the exercise from the original Reference Remix run.
A's narration is shorter with more pacing room; B's estimated duration also fits the request. Neither was actually timed.
pairs.preference_reason: B slightly reduces the reviewer's assembly/navigation burden and provides a complete new multi-reference exercise. That matters to a launch blocked on making one reviewable proof today. This preference is bounded by the absence of browser-layout or human-use testing.
possible_unblinding_clues: B README and CHECKS.json mention a coordinator-reported earlier model-capacity failure and inherited settings. This study-process metadata could reveal chronology to someone who knew the runs; it did not disclose an arm label and was not used to infer identity.

overall_limits: No critical factual, rights, identity-preservation, or scope error was found in the reviewed artifacts.
All six artifacts are usable for their requested local review; equal 8/8 common scores do not erase the small case-specific differences recorded separately.
These are three one-off matched pairs on different tasks. No statistical, causal, general efficacy, speedup, timing, or cost conclusion follows.
Keep all outputs and draft package status. Wider varied trials and outside use remain necessary.
freeze_statement: This judgment was completed and written before any request for or disclosure of the anonymous variant mapping. It will not be revised in response to labels.
